name: open-signal-ai
description: OPEN SIGNAL AI — multi-tenant Telegram Mini App platform (admin panel + API + Mini App)

scripts.dev:api: npm run preflight && npm run dev -w @open-signal/api
scripts.build: npm run preflight && npm run build -w @open-signal/admin && npm run build -w @open-signal/miniapp
scripts.typecheck: npm run preflight && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w @open-signal/admin && npm run typecheck -w @open-signal/miniapp
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
